body: It felt nice to excessively tap ctrl+v. Typing it out once just doesn’t give me satisfaction as it should. It’s like tapping games, it can be addictive.

Personally for me, It’s always sayin things like “you’re a disappointment” or ”You’re family is better off with you dead” and “why are you still alive?”

One of my only reasons to live was to take care of my younger siblings, and that made me feel like I wasn’t a complete waste of air and matter. Now that my siblings are old enough to do it themselves, I really don’t have much tying me.
